736750101.text: Oh, this is great! It's a well-dressed stranger instead of someone from the Eremites or Treasure Hoarders. Alright, I must seize this opportunity!

736750102.text: Umm... "Wayfaring friend, please, wait a second before you venture forth!"

736750105.text: "Good day, bracket, address them as sir or ma'am based on their gender, bracket. Terribly sorry to bother you, but please take some time out of your busy schedule to... uh... give ear to my request."

736750107.text: Wait, wait, please don't interrupt me just yet, or I'll forget my lines. My next line should be...

736750108.text: "Bracket, describe the difficulty you've encountered concisely... and politely ask for their help, then thank them in a formal manner, bracket."

736750109.text: And the last line is... "Bracket, example, bracket. I'd be truly grateful for your kindness and generosity. Your good deed shall be remembered forever."

736750110.text: "In the meantime, I'm willing to pay you handsomely for your hard work, so please, I implore you to give my request some serious consideration."

736750111.text: Phew. Now that I didn't miss a single word this time, it shouldn't be a problem at all. Alright, I'll leave the Future Stars to you then.

736750112.text: Sounds like you have a favor to ask us, but Paimon's really not following...

736750113.text: Huh? How come? According to 50 Things Every Traveling Scholar Should Know, that was exactly what you should say when asking strangers for help. There shouldn't be a problem...
